description: This file defines the AuthCodeEntity class implementing OAuth2 authorization code logic, including properties and methods for managing OAuth authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 authorization code with properties for redirect URI, identifier, expiry, user, client, and scopes, implementing the AuthCodeEntityInterface.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time, overriding to UTC and adding TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes associated with the auth code.
